<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/runs"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns runs across all pipelines, ordered by created_at descending (most recent first). Supports optional filtering by pipeline_id, status, trigger_kind, started_after, and started_before. limit defaults to 50; offset defaults to 0.

  as={"h2"}
